contradictions.summary: Eagle Mountain City's April 20, 2026 article says the April 17 milestone placed the final beam on the first QTS building; QTS/Layton's April 17, 2026 release says the milestone was the third building topping out. Both are construction milestones and neither proves occupancy or energization.

Eagle Mountain City's 2025 restart article describes a water-free cooling system that eliminates water from the cooling process, while the April 2026 city and QTS/Layton releases describe closed-loop cooling that does not consume water for cooling once operational. These are compatible directionally but use different wording and should not be converted into a precise water-use estimate.
